_comment: TEMPLATE. BindCraft's target document, minus the three keys the harness
writes per task: design_path, number_of_final_designs, and
target_hotspot_residues. Preflight refuses this file if it sets any of
them -- an authored value would not be the one the run uses.
starting_pdb must be absolute and must be the campaign's
target.structure_pdb; chains must be the campaign's target.chain_id.
BindCraft ignores unknown keys, so this comment is inert.
